mathematical_scope: An archive builder for phase 17 and the complete phase-16 checkpoint; no mathematical algorithm.
input_and_guard_coverage: Top-level code checks PREVIOUS and START exist. It does not assert CURRENT exists before scanning, pin an expected ancestor hash, or verify the manifest against the actual archived bytes. It excludes SHA256SUMS.txt and validation.log but may include other unintended files. Hard-coded /mnt/data paths and import-time writes require an isolated intended environment.
cost_and_scaling: Reads complete files to hash and again through ZIP writing; compression and testzip are proportional to total payload size, with per-file materialization memory. Embedded historical checkpoints can dominate size.
test_evidence: Post-build checks test ZIP CRC integrity, required member names, and duplicate member names. There is no rerun here and no test of ancestor identity or manifest contents.
dependency_identity: pathlib/hashlib/zipfile/json only; external START, CURRENT contents and PREVIOUS archives are not hash-pinned in source.

findings.finding: Manifest digests are computed before a second read by z.write; files changing between those reads can make manifest and ZIP disagree. CRC/name tests do not detect that mismatch. previous_chain_sha256 is measured after writing, so it is not by itself an identity attestation for the bytes embedded.

acceptance_boundary: Accept only as packaging logic. Its recorded presence or source review does not prove an archive was built or preserved correctly. This audit supplies its own independent source preservation receipt.
